# KP Glass & Aluminum

> KP Glass & Aluminum Ltd. is a commercial glass and aluminum company in Dartmouth, Nova Scotia, serving all of Halifax Regional Municipality (HRM). We provide commercial glazing, curtain wall, storefronts, aluminum entrances, architectural cladding, glass replacement, automatic door operators, and service and repairs for new construction, renovations, and ongoing building maintenance. Licensed and insured, Red Seal technicians, AAADM certified, A+ BBB rated. Free estimates.

## Contact
- Address: 191 Joseph Zatzman Drive, Unit 11-13, Dartmouth, NS B3B 1M5, Canada
- Phone: 902-406-2595
- Email: info@kp-glass.ca (general inquiries, quotes, and resumes)
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM Atlantic Time. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/novascotiaglass/
- LinkedIn: https://ca.linkedin.com/company/kp-glass

## Services
- Curtain wall and storefronts: aluminum systems for commercial and institutional buildings
- Commercial doors and entrances: aluminum entrance systems, glass entrance doors, high-performance commercial doors
- Glass replacement and interior glazing: storefront glass, interior and office glass, reception glass, shower glass, glass railings
- Architectural cladding, coordinated with glazing and aluminum work
- Automatic door operators and accessibility: automatic sliding doors, door operators, accessible entrances (AAADM certified). Washroom accessibility: door hardware and accessibility features designed to support safe and convenient washroom access. Ramps, washroom renovations, and other construction work are coordinated with sister company Creek Ocean Construction.
- Service and repairs for glazing, aluminum doors, windows, and automatic door operators
- Accessibility funding may be available for eligible projects, depending on current programs and application requirements.

## Key facts
- Service area: all of HRM, including Halifax, Dartmouth, Bedford, Sackville, and surrounding communities. Projects outside HRM are reviewed case by case.
- Warranty: 1 year on workmanship; main product Windspec carries a 2-year warranty from date of invoice.
- Permits can be handled by KP or by the client. KP can design or build from supplied plans.
- Clients include general contractors, property managers, building owners, businesses, institutions, developers, and residential clients. Much of the work is commercial.
- Featured projects: Shannex (West Bedford Transitional Health), Dalhousie University Killam Memorial Library, IKEA Halifax.
- Sister companies: Creek Ocean Construction (general contracting, renovations, custom millwork): https://creek.construction/ and Fabtek (aluminum fabrication and supply). Contact KP for installation and service, Fabtek for fabrication and supply.
